##### Project general facts

Palm Springs is a residential community by Nakheel that brings together contemporary villas and townhouses within a nature-led masterplan of green corridors, waterways and landscaped gardens. The Rancho villas offer four- and five-bedroom layouts with expansive living areas and en-suite bedrooms, while the Aliso townhouses provide three- and four-bedroom homes with a more intimate scale and private gardens. Distinctive architecture, elegant proportions and walkable streets give the neighbourhood a relaxed, resort-like character.

At the heart of the community, Canyon Park stretches as a continuous landscape of sensory gardens, streams, ponds, gentle waterfalls, shallow pools and small sandy beaches linked by shaded pathways. Thousand Palms Country Club gathers a beach-inspired pool, kids' pools, splash pads, play areas, a gym, restaurants and an event lawn in one social hub. Silver Spur Racquet Club adds tennis and basketball courts, a fitness space and a pool, and cycling and jogging tracks run through the greenery.

Interiors are shaped by panoramic windows and sliding doors that draw natural light deep into the home and open onto private courtyards, gardens and, in the villas, private pools. Refined finishes, warm natural tones and carefully planned layouts give every room a clear purpose, and district cooling keeps the homes quiet and comfortable with less equipment on the roof.

##### Location description and benefits

Hessyan First lies on the mainland side of Palm Jebel Ali in southwest Dubai, between the Jebel Ali coast and Sheikh Zayed Road. The area sits within the core urban zone of the Dubai master plan and borders the Jebel Ali coastline and its natural reserve, combining open landscapes with direct access to the city's main growth corridor.

A nearby metro station and Sheikh Zayed Road connect the district with Bluewaters Island, Palm Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab, while Expo Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road lead to Expo City and Al Maktoum International Airport. Schools, clinics and retail in Al Furjan, Discovery Gardens and Ibn Battuta Mall are within easy reach, and the beaches and marinas of Palm Jebel Ali complete the lifestyle offer.

The southwest corridor of Dubai attracts families and long-term residents looking for larger homes, green surroundings and good connectivity. Freehold ownership for international buyers, the planned growth of Palm Jebel Ali and new mixed-use destinations nearby support steady rental demand and long-term capital appreciation in the area.
